item.youjosenki.elenium_type95_flight_un: Tanya Degurechaff's high-output quad-core prototype. Extreme aerial maneuverability, single-leg strut, and 1,000,000 FE capacity.
item.youjosenki.elenium_type97_flight_un: Imperial Army 203rd Aerial Mage Battalion standard combat apparatus. Balanced 500,000 FE storage.
item.youjosenki.republic_type101_flight_: Allied Francois Republic streamlined delta-wing apparatus. High aerodynamic glide and 750,000 FE storage.
item.youjosenki.federation_type82_flight: Russy Federation heavy armored rocket rig. Extreme reinforced chassis and massive 1,500,000 FE power cell.
item.youjosenki.allied_type1923_flight_u: Unified States Marine aerial apparatus. High-thrust chrome dual turbines and 850,000 FE capacity.
item.youjosenki.commonwealth_mk2_flight_: Allied Kingdom royal aeronautical flight rig. Precision brass mechanics and 650,000 FE capacity.
item.youjosenki.entente_skirig_flight_un: Legadonia Entente Alliance mountain warfare rig. Ultra-lightweight construction with 600,000 FE capacity.
Modern combat twin-turbine jetpack. Dual thruster exhaust bells, balanced fuel injection, and 800,000 FE capacity.
item.youjosenki.heavy_industrial_rocket_: Industrial hazardous-duty heavy rocket pack. Colossal dual rocket fuel tanks and colossal 2,500,000 FE energy reservoir.
item.youjosenki.shadow_recon_wings.lore: Special Operations stealth delta wing-pack. Hypersonic swept wing blades, wingtip micro-jets, and 1,000,000 FE capacity.
item.youjosenki.elenium_type95_exo.lore: Doctor Schugel's ultimate miraculous prototype with twin synchronized Elenium cores, dual-leg articulated mechanical exoskeleton, shoulder radiator winglets, and 2,000,000 FE capacity.
item.youjosenki.titan_siege_frame.lore: Massive heavy armored siege assault frame. Over-shoulder stabilizer gantries, reactive chest mantlet, quad rocket booster matrix, and 3,500,000 FE storage.
item.youjosenki.valkyrie_thrust_boots.lo: Tactical dual-leg rocket hover greaves. Low-altitude terrain skate (110m), extreme long-distance rocket dash, superior ground movement speed (+35%), and all-weather submersible waterproofing.
item.youjosenki.aquasurf_skimmer_unit.lo: High-speed water skimming apparatus. Unsinkable positive buoyancy, rapid water-ski locomotion with spray wake, low flight ceiling (76m), and 700,000 FE power cell.
item.youjosenki.abyssal_scuba_rig.lore: Sub-surface tactical diving rig with rear oxygen cylinders and front air scrubber. Equip together with Abyssal Diving Mask for full 2-piece set synergy (infinite air, clear vision, fast swim). Land jump restricted due to ballast weight. 800,000 FE.
item.youjosenki.abyssal_diving_mask.lore: Specialized deep-sea panoramic visor and oral-nasal rebreather mask. Equipping both Scuba Rig and Diving Mask grants full 2-piece diving synergy with infinite air and rapid propulsion. 200,000 FE.
item.youjosenki.urban_scout_exolegs.lore: Full-body tactical exoskeleton featuring articulated spine vertebrae, shoulder cantilevers, arm actuators, and hydraulic leg struts. Grants high jump clearance, sprint forward kinetic dash, and fall shock absorption. Compatible with other flight rigs! 300,000 FE.
